lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are organized into approximately five vertical columns. The centroids within the mid-flank region exhibit semi-regular vertical spacing, forming a repetitive grid-like arrangement posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of blobs. The blobs act as high-intensity nodes situated directly upon these vertical bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-luminance pixels on the dorsal side to low-luminance shadow pixels on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin contains a dense distribution of small, circular high-luminance markers that are significantly smaller in diameter and more closely packed than the blobs on the lateral flank.
